# content-automerge allowlist — THE source of truth for what may merge with no
# human review.
#
# `.github/workflows/auto-merge-content.yml` reads THIS FILE (from `main`, via
# the API — never from the PR head) and enables GitHub auto-merge only when
# every changed path in a PR starts with one of the prefixes below. One path
# outside the list and the PR waits for a founder. That is the fail-safe
# direction, so keep this list narrow.
#
# ⚠️ EDITING THIS FILE CHANGES MERGE AUTHORITY. Adding a line means bots can
# land that path with nobody looking. Only add paths that are CONTENT: seed
# data, or an artifact mechanically DERIVED from seed data by a sync script.
# Never app code, never anything hand-authored, and never the rest of
# `apps/web/public/**` (see docs/decisions.md 2026-07-28 — a bot-picked image
# gets human eyes). ONE exception: `apps/web/public/social/`, carved out by
# docs/decisions.md 2026-08-11 (checker-gated social images — approved by
# Joey and Wyatt, superseding the 2026-07-28 note for this one directory
# only). That path is a plain prefix match here same as any other entry, but
# `.github/workflows/auto-merge-content.yml`'s `enable` job applies EXTRA
# per-file constraints to it (must be .png/.jpg/.jpeg, ≤1.5MB, a regular git
# blob — not a symlink/submodule) that this file has no way to express, since
# it only ever sees paths, never file properties. A file under that prefix
# failing those constraints still declines, same as any other non-content
# path would.
#
# THE SELF-AMENDMENT BAR (2026-08-11). Some paths are not a judgement call and
# CI refuses them outright: `.github/**`, `scripts/**`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`,
# `docs/agents/**`, `docs/decisions.md`, `docs/proposals/**`, `docs/specs/**`,
# `docs/content-ops/**`, `package.json`, lockfiles, config, migrations, and
# `apps/web/public/**` (EXCEPT the `apps/web/public/social/` carve-out above).
# Those paths change *what merges with nobody looking, or what agents are
# permitted to do* — allowlisting one would let a bot PR widen its own authority
# and land the widening unreviewed. The mechanism that decides what merges
# without a human must itself always need a human. The full list and the reason
# per path: NEVER_ALLOWLIST in scripts/check-automerge-allowlist.mjs; the single
# narrowing (the social carve-out) is NEVER_ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS there.
#
# Format: one path prefix per line, matched with a literal `startsWith`.
#   - `#` starts a comment; blank lines ignored.
#   - Directory prefixes MUST end in `/` (`docs/audits` would also match
#     `docs/auditsX/`).
#   - Every entry must name a path that actually exists.
#
# `npm run check:automerge-allowlist` (CI, in `build`) enforces all of the
# above AND that every apps/web/lib/longlive/*.generated.ts is either listed
# here or explicitly excluded in scripts/check-automerge-allowlist.mjs. A new
# generated file therefore cannot go silently un-auto-mergeable — which is the
# bug this file exists to prevent (PRs #1891/#1762 sat a week because
# theories.generated.ts was never added to the old inline list).

# ── Seed data: the authored source of truth for all Vault content. ──────────
supabase/seed/

# ── Social queue: drafted posts (per docs/decisions.md 2026-07-25). ─────────
social/queue/

# ── Audit reports written by the content-engine runners. ────────────────────
docs/audits/

# ── Social images: ONE narrow exception to the apps/web/public/** rule above
#    (docs/decisions.md 2026-08-11 — checker-gated, per-file constraints
#    enforced by the workflow, not by this file). A queue item's own
#    dedicated photo, already validated by scripts/social/check-drafts.mjs's
#    media rules in the check-drafts job. ────────────────────────────────────
apps/web/public/social/

# ── Built vault: machine-generated from supabase/seed/** by the sync scripts
#    listed in scripts/lib/generated-content.mjs. Never hand-edited; `npm run
#    check:generated` fails if any of these drifts from its seeds. ───────────
apps/web/lib/longlive/content-vault.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/tracks.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/theories.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/videos.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/song-moods.generated.ts
